fields.description: Maximum tokens to use for page context
fields.label: Max Context Tokens

fields.description: Allow extracting visible content from page DOM (recommended for better context)
fields.label: Enable DOM Content Extraction

fields.description: Record browser console errors and failed requests so the assistant can diagnose on-screen problems. Nothing is sent until the user approves a capture.
fields.label: Enable Browser Diagnostics

fields.description: When enabled, a daily scheduler purges old archived conversations according to the retention window below. Disable to retain messages indefinitely.
fields.label: Enable Retention Cleanup

fields.description: Archived conversations older than this many days are permanently deleted. Active (non-archived) conversations are never auto-deleted. Minimum 30 days.
fields.label: Message Retention (days)

fields.description: Also delete File attachments (images, uploads) linked to purged messages. Disable to keep attachments on disk.
fields.label: Delete Attachments on Purge
